description: This file contains platform-specific socket utility functions for SCTP protocol support on Linux, including IP address conversion, socket capability probing, and socket option configuration.

classes.name: ipStackCapabilities
classes.description: Struct to hold IPv4 and IPv6 support capabilities with synchronization.

classes.name: SCTPAddr
classes.description: Struct representing SCTP address with IP addresses.

methods.name: boolint
methods.description: Converts a boolean to an integer (true=1, false=0).

methods.name: ipToSockaddr
methods.description: Converts IP address and port to syscall.Sockaddr based on address family.

methods.name: sockaddr
methods.description: Creates syscall.Sockaddr from net.TCPAddr and address family.

methods.name: supportsIPv4
methods.description: Checks if platform supports IPv4 networking.

methods.name: supportsIPv6
methods.description: Checks if platform supports IPv6 networking.

methods.name: supportsIPv4map
methods.description: Checks if platform supports IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses.

methods.name: probe
methods.description: Probes kernel support for IPv4, IPv6, and IPv4-mapped IPv6.

methods.name: isWildcard
methods.description: Checks if SCTP address is a wildcard address.

methods.name: family
methods.description: Determines the address family (IPv4 or IPv6) for SCTP address.

methods.name: favoriteAddrFamily
methods.description: Determines preferred address family for network mode and addresses.

methods.name: setDefaultSockopts
methods.description: Sets default socket options for SCTP sockets, including IPv6 and broadcast options.
